details:
**Q1: What part of this repository should be improved?**
Choices:
- **A** — A specific workflow or script; I will name the exact file/path (RECOMMENDED)
- **B** — A specific pipeline phase; I will name the phase (`clarify`, `plan`, `implement`, `review_autofix`, `orchestrate`, `validate`)
- **C** — The whole repository / general quality improvements
Reply: `Q1: A`
**Q2: What kind of improvement do you want?**
Choices:
- **A** — Fix a concrete bug or failing behavior (RECOMMENDED)
- **B** — Improve reliability/performance without changing intended behavior
- **C** — Add or change functionality/automation behavior
- **D** — Improve docs/readability/maintainability only
Reply: `Q2: A`
**Q3: What should be treated as the acceptance criterion?**
Choices:
- **A** — I will describe the exact before/after behavior or failure that should be fixed (RECOMMENDED)
- **B** — Match an existing issue/PR/workflow run that I will reference
- **C** — Apply a general cleanup with no specific behavioral target
Reply: `Q3: A`
**Q4: How broad should the change be?**
Choices:
- **A** — Minimal targeted fix only (RECOMMENDED)
- **B** — Fix the main issue plus closely related code in the same area
- **C** — Broader cross-repo cleanup/refactor
Reply: `Q4: A`
